title: Time
parentNote: Use a real clock (or a toy clock with movable hands) to show each o'clock and half-past position — it's much clearer than a picture alone.
learnBullets: Days of the week and months of the year, in order
Simple elapsed time (how much time has passed)
learnItFirst:
**Reading the clock:**
```
🕒 = 3 o'clock       (short hand on 3, long hand on 12)
🕜 = half past 1      (short hand between 1 and 2, long hand on 6)
```

**Handy facts to remember:**
| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Days in a week | 7 |
| Months in a year | 12 |
| Hours in a day | 24 |
| Minutes in an hour | 60 |
| Minutes in half an hour | 30 |

**AM and PM:** AM = morning (midnight to noon). PM = afternoon, evening, and night (noon to midnight).

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Look** at the short hand for the hour, the long hand for the minutes.
2. For "how many hours/days later," **count forward** one step at a time.
3. Remember the **order**: Sunday→Saturday for days, January→December for months.

---

questions.content: How many days are there in a week?
questions.why: A week has 7 days

questions.content: How many months are there in a year?
questions.why: A year has 12 months

questions.content: Which day comes right AFTER Monday?
questions.why: The day right after Monday is Tuesday

questions.content: Which day comes right BEFORE Sunday?
questions.why: The day right before Sunday is Saturday

questions.content: How many hours are there in one day?
questions.why: A day has 24 hours

questions.content: How many minutes are there in one hour?
questions.why: An hour has 60 minutes

questions.content: 🕜 shows what time?
questions.why: The short hand is between 1 and 2, showing half past 1

questions.content: 🕝 shows what time?
questions.why: The short hand is between 2 and 3, showing half past 2

questions.content: Which day comes FIRST in the week: Wednesday or Friday?
questions.why: In the week's order, Wednesday comes before Friday

questions.content: Which month comes right AFTER March?
questions.why: The month right after March is April

questions.content: Which month comes right BEFORE December?
questions.why: The month right before December is November

questions.content: It is 4 o'clock now. What time will it be after 2 hours?
It is 10 o'clock now. What time was it 3 hours ago?
Which is correct?

options.A: AM is morning, PM is afternoon/evening
options.B: AM is night, PM is morning
options.C: AM and PM mean the same thing
options.D: Neither AM nor PM means anything

questions.why: This is the correct meaning of AM and PM

questions.content: School starts at 8 AM. Is this in the morning or evening?
questions.why: AM stands for morning time

questions.content: A movie starts at 7 PM. Is this in the morning or evening?
questions.why: PM stands for afternoon/evening/night time

questions.content: How many days does February usually have (in a normal year)?
questions.why: February has 28 days in a normal (non-leap) year

questions.content: How many days does the month of April have?
questions.why: April has 30 days

questions.content: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 7 days?
questions.why: 7 days is exactly one full week, so it returns to the same day

questions.content: If today is Tuesday, what day was it 2 days ago?
questions.why: Going back: Monday (1 day ago), Sunday (2 days ago)

questions.content: Half of an hour is how many minutes?
questions.why: Half of 60 minutes is 30 minutes

questions.content: A class starts at 9:30 and ends at 10:30. How long is the class?
questions.why: From 9:30 to 10:30 is exactly 1 hour
